Precon Rip re-run with Hulk at S: Hulk now gets Professor Hulk (from Nick Fury), Swiftfoot Boots (from Wizards), Overwhelming Stampede (from Teval), Unstable Molecule Suit (from Cap: Shield Throw), Talisman of Creativity (from Sinister Six), Terramorphic Expanse (from Black Panther) and Seize the Day (from the binder), on top of Eternal Witness, Avengers Tower, Baxter Building, Path of Ancestry, Rootbound Crag, Farseek and Three Visits. Nov 23, 2026: Unstable Molecule Suit in for Lightning Greaves (all versions built off this list). Greaves' shroud blocked our own self-damage tricks on Hulk; the Suit's indestructible doesn't. Swiftfoot Boots stays (hexproof only stops opponents).

v2, Nov 18, 2026 — Big Ramp + Finishers (High Bracket 2, 0 Game Changers): ramp into big Gammas, then end it with extra combats. Self-damage on an attacking Incredible Hulk = untap + extra combat: Red Hulk's enrage ping (target your own Hulk), Iron Fist's ping, Brash Taunter fights, and instant fights Pounce / Inscription of Abundance cast during combat. Finishers: Fiery Emancipation (triples all damage), Savage Beating, Relentless Assault, Seize the Day, Unnatural Growth, Overwhelming Stampede.

Bracket 2 guardrails: no Caltrops in the main list — Caltrops + attacking Hulk is an infinite-combat win (it's in the Bracket 3 version on purpose). Single pingers like Cunning Sparkmage or Prodigal Sorcerer are NOT infinite (they don't untap) — one extra combat each. No Game Changers.
Skipped Hulk, Always Angry: his enter trigger destroys all artifacts, including your own rocks and Boots/Greaves.

By request: Elvish Mystic in (for Hulkling), Negate in for Swan Song (not owned right now), Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur in for Tamiyo's Safekeeping (Leader kept), Last March of the Ents in for Origin of the Hulk.

variants.label: Best of Both (Moonmist)
variants.name: Bruce Banner // Hulk: Best of Both
notes: Nov 23, 2026: Trophy Mage in for Hulk, Bruce Banner (a vanilla 7/4). Trophy Mage's enter trigger finds any mana-value-3 artifact: Caltrops, or Unstable Molecule Suit if Caltrops is already handled. Tamiyo's Safekeeping comes in via the main list (for Abomination, Terrifying Titan).
Nov 19, 2026: best-of-both build — the Bracket 3 (Caltrops) shell + the primer's mana base, recursion and Moonmist. 99 + Bruce, 35 lands (incl. Bala Ged Recovery as a land), 3 Game Changers.

Why Moonmist (Andrew's call): these tables run heavy removal, so a creature combo has to rebuild fast. When Hulk dies, recast Bruce for {U} + tax and Moonmist him at the end of an opponent's turn instead of paying 6 + tax for Hulk.

MOONMIST RULE: it prevents combat damage from every non-Werewolf/Wolf that turn, Hulk included. Cast it at the end of an opponent's turn (or any turn you won't attack), never on your attack turn. Caltrops and Pyrohemia damage isn't combat damage, so that's unaffected.

Combo lines: (1) Bruce early → Moonmist on an opponent's end step → Caltrops + attack. (2) Gifts pile: Caltrops + Eternal Witness + Bala Ged Recovery + Noxious Revival (or Call Damage Control / Regrowth). (3) Gamble or Trophy Mage for Caltrops; recursion fixes a bad Gamble discard. Without Caltrops: Pyrohemia (one extra combat per R), Sandstorm, Cunning Sparkmage, Iron Fist, Red Hulk, fight spells.
Backup if the combo is answered: Flora Colossus, The Thing, Shang-Chi, Natural Order, Last March of the Ents, Unnatural Growth, Fiery Emancipation, Savage Beating.

Interaction kept: Beast Within, Chaos Warp, Counterspell, Arcane Denial, Negate, Pounce, Inscription of Abundance, HULK SMASH!, Epic Fight, Avengers Disassembled; protection: Heroic Intervention, Tamiyo's Safekeeping, Strength of Will, Swiftfoot Boots, Unstable Molecule Suit.
variants.source: Built by Claude from the Bracket 3 (Caltrops) version + the primer list, Nov 19, 2026

variants.label: Primer: Caltrops Combo
variants.name: Bruce Banner // Hulk: Temur Caltrops Combo (primer list)
notes: Primer summary: Temur midrange-combo. Early ramp + Bruce drawing; Moonmist transforms Bruce into Hulk cheaply; tutor Caltrops with Gifts Ungiven, Whir of Invention or Gamble; Caltrops + attacking Hulk = infinite combats. Backup: Hulk, Strongest There Is, World War Hulk, Unnatural Growth, Last March of the Ents. Pyrohemia and Iron Fist give extra combats without Caltrops.

Primer Gifts piles: (1) Caltrops + Eternal Witness + Bala Ged Recovery + Noxious Revival; (2) with Caltrops in hand: Heroic Intervention + Moonmist + Arcane Denial + Noxious Revival. Whir of Invention for X=3 at end of turn puts Caltrops onto the battlefield.
Mulligan (primer): keep 2–3 lands, a 1–2 mana ramp piece, and draw or a tutor/combo piece; ship slow hands of 5+ mana Hulks.

Claude review Nov 19, 2026: She-Hulk, Attorney-at-Law has a {G/W} hybrid cost, so her colour identity includes white — not legal under Bruce. Moonmist prevents combat damage from non-Werewolves that turn, so cast it at the end of an opponent's turn (or a turn before attacking), never in the combat turn. A turn-3 two-card win plays at Bracket 4 regardless of Game Changer count. Runs no Sol Ring.
variants.source: Primer + decklist provided by Andrew, Nov 19, 2026 (100 cards incl. Bruce)
